correctness.rationale: The stationary phase law is pi_i=r_i/R. The finite Poisson-corrector equation gives p*u_i-q*u_(i-1)=v*r_i and C=R^{-1}sum_i u_i^2. Inverting the cyclic first-difference operator gives the explicit exponential pair kernel. For integer gap sums, strict convexity forces the balanced mechanical word as the unique minimizer up to rotation; strict convexity on the continuous gaps simplex forces a vertex (the clustered word) for every maximizer. 336 exact-rational independent Poisson/generator comparisons and exhaustive configurations through period 10 corroborate the analytic argument. Boundaries and equality cases checked.

value.rationale: The problem fixes the physically relevant hopping bias, count and strength of slow sites, drift and entropy production while varying only microscopic placement; it asks a complete natural transport-fluctuation optimization question.
